hook.name: ZayyanXPADHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-scaled quote-side fee on every swap in Uniswap v4 pools opened with zero LP fee, collecting fees as ERC-6909 claims and forwarding them to a designated fee wallet. The fee rate adjusts between a configurable base and maximum BPS (capped at 5.3%) based on the tick movement of the previous swap.
